issue.title: SAVE10 and SAVE25 coupons have no effect on the cart total
issue.body:
Run: dotnet run -- --items "Mug:20:2,Shirt:10:1" --coupon SAVE10 (items total 50.00).
Expected: discount 5.00, total 45.00.
Actual: discount 0, total 50.00. Same for SAVE25. Unknown coupons correctly do nothing, valid ones silently do nothing too.
